caption: St. Mark's Basilica, Venice

description: The camera stands in Piazza San Marco facing the floodlit west facade of St. Mark's Basilica, its five arched portals and gilded domes glowing warm against the night sky. The red-brick campanile rises at the left edge while the lamplit arcades of the Procuratie close both sides of the square. The modelled scenario is 23 September 2026 at 05:00 Europe/Rome: a pre-dawn night view over a nearly empty pavement, not a verified on-site observation.
